scope.description: One evidence-bounded organization refresh lead from the July 21 to July 29 overlap. BOREALIS and the existing Defence Drone Initiative remain explicitly deferred rather than becoming duplicate records.

source.title: Volatus Aerospace Advances Canada's Next Chapter in Autonomous Aviation
source.locator: July 8 press release, Transport Canada PVD acceptance and Canary RPAS description
source.summary: Volatus Aerospace announced that Transport Canada accepted its Canary remotely piloted aircraft system under the Pre-Validated Declaration process.

leads.evidenceLocator: Volatus July 8 official release plus CanadaBuys July 9 award record
followUpQuestions: Confirm whether CanadaBuys supplier name Volatus Drones Canada is the same legal entity or a related operating name for the published Volatus Aerospace record.
Confirm the reviewer wants current activity recorded without elevating either public record into a defence award or endorsement claim.
reviewWarnings: CanadaBuys names Volatus Drones Canada, while the published target is Volatus Aerospace; do not assert legal-entity equivalence without reviewer confirmation.
The DFO RPAS award is a civil public-procurement record and does not establish a National Defence contract, procurement eligibility, endorsement or classified demand.
leads.refreshSummary: Add bounded, current public activity to the existing Volatus Aerospace profile: Volatus's own Canary PVD announcement and the separately named CanadaBuys DFO RPAS award, without creating a contract relationship or resolving the supplier-name question automatically.
intendedChanges: Add current activity text that separates Volatus Aerospace's official Canary PVD announcement from the CanadaBuys supplier-name award.
Add an evidence-boundary note that prohibits treating the DFO award as legal-entity equivalence, a defence award, endorsement or classified demand.
